status: MODEL (search over the physical design space: area conservation + per-unit limits + K3 detailed replay; not FROZEN, does not change the published point)
owner: Hardware (package / power / RAS); co-sign Council (system budget)

constraints: die area <= 400 mm2 and die power <= 300 W, both including any keep-out and port scaling the candidate charges
card power <= 3200 W (ADR-0026; the MC term and the fixed overhead are charged, not assumed away)
package area (dies + cubes) + reserve <= the 5248 mm2 placement window
PHY shoreline <= the die edge budget (4 x sqrt(dieArea) x phyEdgeFraction); the published point sits at 24.21 / 52.95 mm and this constraint is what a naive lane increase breaks first
the K3 detailed replay at the candidate reaches the contract target of requirements.contractEntry
every area term must be classifiable as logic, SRAM or PHY: k3_physical_basis.resize throws on an unclassified term, and that must stay true
objective: most conservative keep-out premise (a smaller keep-out is a stronger claim about what the vendor accepts, and nothing in this repository supports it)
largest package area reserve within that premise (the placement window is the resource that cannot be bought back later)
largest die power margin below the cooling ceiling
lowest process risk (a scaled basis is a promise about a node, not a measurement)
designSpace.note: only the winning design is written here; the alternatives stay in the design space and in the document

caliber.dieArea: per compute die, mm2, on the searched process basis, including the charged shared-port scaling cost
caliber.diePower: per compute die, W, at the published frequency
caliber.cardPower: per card = 8 x diePower + the MC term + fixed overhead, W
caliber.packageArea: sum of all placed logic area in the placement window, mm2, before keep-out
caliber.reason: package area conservation is stated as placed area + keep-out = usable window; a candidate that only balances the identity without comparing against the 5248 mm2 window has not been checked against the spec

assumptions.coolingNote: ASSUMPTION (O-015): the repository has no thermal model; cooling selects which ceiling applies, it does not derive one
assumptions.processSource: integration/detailed/k3_physical_basis.js (ASSUMPTION B-006: public node figures, not PDK or macro data)

process.evidence: k3_physical_basis.js BASIS.process; logic 57x32 / 51x28 = 1.277, SRAM 0.0262 / 0.021 = 1.248, PHY unscaled. ASSUMPTION (B-006): public node figures, not PDK or macro data. This is the published point

matrixTFPerMm2.evidence: k3_physical_basis.js BASIS.matrixTFPerMm2; 0.000625 mm2 per BF16 MAC, twice the historical value. ASSUMPTION (B-006), needs a MAC-array macro. This is the published point

cooling.evidence: card.cooling and BASIS.limits (ADR-0005, decision 2026-09-25, card limit raised 2800 -> 3200 W by ADR-0026): cold plate, die 300 W, card 3200 W. This is the published point. ASSUMPTION (O-015): cold plate, VRM and card power delivery are not modelled

reserveFraction.evidence: the published point: 658.29 / 5248, from document section 1. Recorded as the observed value, not a chosen one

dieCount.reason: ADR-0018 fixes the 7-reticle package boundary and the 4x2 die arrangement; a single larger die would exceed the reticle limit. The count is the given, not a searched dimension, so it appears here rather than as a dimension the search pretends to explore

frequency.reason: card.powerLimitW is the binding constraint at the published point (2744.88 / 2800 W, 98.0% used), and the physical strategy explicitly prefers lowering frequency over relaxing thermal margin. UNVERIFIED: no voltage/frequency curve is in the repository, so a frequency sweep cannot be scored here

nearMemoryCompute.chosen: no compute inside the cube, cube area stays at the planning 100 mm2
nearMemoryCompute.reason: architectureRoute keeps near-memory compute out of the baseline; 16 x 100 mm2 = 1600 mm2 is 30% of the window, and any growth there comes out of the reserve

thermals.chosen: cooling carried as an ASSUMPTION (O-015), limits checked but not derived
thermals.reason: the repository has no thermal model: no theta-JA, no cold-plate curve, no ambient. A search that scored die power against a derived temperature would be inventing the model. The dimension is limited to which ceiling applies, and the document states the limitation

degradation.chosen: failure degradation is a route with a stated result, checked in the document, not searched here
degradation.reason: the physical strategy requires a degradation mode with a route and a performance result; the repository has no per-failure performance model to score one with. UNVERIFIED and deliberately excluded, so the space does not imply it was scored

regenerate: node integration/pipelines/generate_physical_design.js (npm run physical:search); enforced by tests/regression/test_physical_design.js
